label: Tractarian logical space: laws, model and joint route model
paraphrase: Premise-free comparison. Laws, for all types: on the truth-functional fragment Kripke truth at a world is truth-functional truth under its atomic profile; tautologies are boxed at every world of every frame; on the fragment NECESSARY_14 K validity, and NECESSARY_13 validity on an inhabited frame, give NECESSARY_16 tautology; tautology gives frame-relative and truth-functional contradictory denial (NECESSARY_5 form), the converses with excluded middle as an explicit antecedent; in combinatorial logical space a box-free formula is boxed exactly when it is a tautology, and any box-free exact existence dictionary for a NECESSARY_2 box-existent bearer is a tautology. Model, worlds = all assignments to two states of affairs, universal access: logical space, S5, only logical necessity; every state of affairs possible, possibly not and not boxed; two distinct objects that exist at every world are both NECESSARY_2 box-existent and their existence is not elementary; the identity tautology is an exact existence dictionary for each object and the atom is not; no boxed formula is a tautology; the K axiom instance with q := p is K-valid but not a tautology (it is a substitution instance of a propositional tautology, so strictness comes only from the fragment restriction and every K-valid box formula is an equal witness); in a contrast ontology whose existence is elementary no candidate is box-existent. Joint route model, on one universal frame over all assignments to one state of affairs: the route's S5 frame premise and the S5 necessary-being node hold for the one-point signature's root, the state-of-affairs valuation forms logical space and satisfies only logical necessity, and the root's existence is not elementary. The one-point signature's divine fields are stipulated, not evidence.
